purpose: Lead's independent check of whether the per-row estimate freeze actually holds when content arrives for rows the reader has never seen.
method: Frozen harness page served standalone; walked up in 250px steps exactly like the harness M4 until an image row sat above the viewport, then called __loadImages() and compared .th-chat-history total size.
conclusion: 6 unmounted image rows x 328px IMAGE_BLOCK_HEIGHT = 1968px, plus the mounted row's own growth, accounts for the entire 1994px. The estimates of rows that were NEVER rendered changed when their content changed, so the freeze did not hold for them - which is exactly the +2063px anchor shift C4 measures.
cleanup: vite 5214 killed, frontend/.qa-probe2 removed, WebView closed
